quote.citation: 1971, Gwen White, Antique Toys And Their Background, page 182:
quote.text: The Thaumatrope was based on the persistence of vision. The disc of card was rotated so rapidly by means of threads attached to it that the eye saw both sides of the card simultaneously.

definitions.definition: (computer science) Of data, the property of continuing to exist after the termination of the program.

Once written to a disk file, the data ha: it will still be there tomorrow when we run the next program.

definitions.definition: (meteorology) Continuation of the previous day's weather (particularly temperature and precipitation statistics).
(mathematics) The number of times an operation can be iteratively applied to a number before it reaches a permanently constant state.
